claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the hair as soft, thick, and bouncy, often noting it holds up well over time.
Many customers say the hair is a great value for the price, exceeding expectations despite initial skepticism about buying hair at this price point.
Several reviewers report little to no shedding and no bad smell.
A few reviewers mention the hair is difficult to color or does not feel like true virgin human hair.
Some customers note fast shipping and appreciate the included free pair of eyelashes, though one did not receive them.
